definitions.short: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed ); generally, a rock or boulder ; figuratively, a refuge ; also an edge (as precipitous )
definitions.usage: edge, × (mighty) God (one), rock, × sharp, stone, × strength, × strong. See also 1049 .
